note: Creates an untrusted GVariant of type 'v' from the raw fuzz input bytes; the variant is marked untrusted so normal-form checks are performed.
Calls g_variant_byteswap on the untrusted variant; since the type 'v' has alignment > 0 and the value is not in normal form, it takes the g_variant_deep_copy path.
For non-normal values with alignment, g_variant_deep_copy is invoked to produce a trusted normal-form copy.
Iterates over children of the variant; for the outer variant type, calls g_variant_get_child_value to extract the contained value.
Calls g_variant_serialised_get_child on the serialised variant data to obtain the child value.
Dispatches to gvs_variant_get_child for the variant type; this parses the embedded type string and returns the child serialised value.
Searches backwards for the NUL terminator in the variant data, sets child.data to the start of the data and child.size to the position of the NUL; the child type is parsed from the type string.

code: if ((!fixed_size || fixed_size == child.size) && value.depth < G_VARIANT_MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH - child_type_depth) return child;
note: For a fixed-size child type, checks that fixed_size equals child.size; if the child type is a tuple with a variable-sized member, fixed_size is 0 so the check passes regardless of child.size.
The returned child (a tuple) is then recursively deep-copied; g_variant_deep_copy calls g_variant_get_child_value on the tuple to process its members.
Calls g_variant_serialised_get_child on the tuple's serialised data to extract a member.
Dispatches to gvs_tuple_get_child for the tuple type; this reads the offset table to determine member bounds.
Calls gvs_tuple_get_member_bounds to compute the start and end offsets of the requested tuple member.

Reads offset_size bytes from the offset table at the end of the tuple data. If offset_size * (member_info->i + 1) > value.size, the pointer arithmetic underflows and reads past the end of the heap buffer, causing a heap-buffer-overflow READ 2 when offset_size is 2.
Reads 2 bytes from the computed pointer; when the pointer is past the end of the heap allocation due to the offset table underflow, this triggers the heap-buffer-overflow READ 2.
